notes.title: [UPDATED] Version 1.4.0 of Robot Legions Reborn now Live!
notes.content:
A batch of minor fixes for Robot Legions Reborn are now available in the latest update:


    Drones spawned in Arcade Mode now despawn on restart
    Second Player eye-catch now disappears after a few seconds of playing Arcade Mode solo (a second player can still enter any time)
    You can now exit Arcade Mode from the Game Over screen
    Small volume settings for Sound/Music no longer display as "[MUTE]"

notes.title: [UPDATED] Version 1.3.0 of Robot Legions Reborn now Live!
notes.content:
We just released an update of Robot Legions Reborn that fixes several Steam achievement bugs. Namely:


    Easy Go achievement not incrementing / unlocking
    Flawless Victory achievement not incrementing / unlocking
    Enemy defeat counters were being triple counted


We tried to fix these bugs in such a way that no one lost progress and that your previously uncounted progress should now be counted.

Sorry for the bugs. 
Please enjoy the game!
